data.title: Automation Conquered the Box. Now Comes the Couch.
data.description: Warehouse automation has become remarkably good at moving standardized boxes, totes and pallets. But what happens when the product is a sofa, mattress or 75-inch television? Walmart's new $300+ million Ohio fulfillment center for large, non-sortable merchandise highlights a growing opportunity for automation: handling everything that does not fit neatly into today's systems.
